decisions.reason: The XL tier of the Athena anamnesis app serves large practices at little cost and supports the firm's paperless-practice strategy, so there is little reason to withdraw it.
Dedicated support for dental assistants uses the firm's core service strength and installed base and helps retain customers.
A materials management module is a natural extension of the practice-management suite and costs little to maintain once it is integrated.
The KIM secure messaging service is a telematics-infrastructure requirement for German dental practices, so it is essential and will stay.
